title: Kitten Garden Smoke Test
global_prompt: The same small tabby kitten beside dense green garden plants, photorealistic nature documentary, stable fur markings, stable facial features, soft natural daylight, shallow depth of field, continuous natural motion
negative_prompt: identity drift, duplicate animal, extra limbs, distorted face, deformed paws, flicker, jitter, sudden scene cut, camera shake, blur, low quality

shots.name: Kitten Looks Up
shots.prompt: The kitten slowly raises its head, looks toward the camera and blinks once, its ears twitch subtly, nearby plant branches sway gently in a light breeze
shots.camera: locked medium shot, no camera movement
